title: "M14 - Standalone Module"
---

## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M14 - Hybrid Retrieval and RAG.

## Technical Scope

- Agata Engine implemented in Python with YAML-driven configuration
- Agata Manager implemented in Java Spring Boot
- Designed for internal engine deployment with manager as exposed integration layer
- Optional Keycloak integration for authentication and authorization
- Deployment quality depends on indexing strategy and backend service capacity

## Run Guidance

Integrate through Agata Manager secure APIs in controlled deployment environments

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
